related_work.work_intent_alignment_status: the persisted WorkIntent predates the current environmental capability campaign objective
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

outcome.interpretation_limit: The real Git worktree and operating-system lock were exercised, but provider side effects were mocked. The concurrency test ran two Environment sessions in one process; process exit recovery was separately verified against the kernel lock. The vertical proof exercised the real read provider and protected-write denial, not an external provider write. No independent agent used the new path during this session.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Manifest verification commands cannot execute under session authority in dirty/foreign checkouts
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment provider effect eligibility and verification
pressure_hypothesis.basis: This uses the existing pressure identity from pressures/registry.json. Its source evidence records a dirty/off-branch mncs-automation test invocation that returned pending-escalation because the checkout had not first been claimed, followed by a direct host unittest workaround. The user also reports repeated authorization friction; broader recurrence and the causes of all reported failures remain unverified.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one prior session recorded in the source pressure registry plus user-reported repeated friction; cross-session system recurrence not established
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: For an exact session-selected non-main linked worktree, evaluate current writable rights and checkout identity without requiring a persistent owner claim, then serialize Environment-mediated effects with an automatically released operation-scoped lock. Preserve scoped requirements for shared main, destructive actions, and whole-tree remediation.
